scientific_integrity: Finite-state exact checks support but do not replace the analytic proof. Published endpoint MSD and occupation scaling results are credited, not presented as new.
scientific_limitations: Uniform independent history relocation and fixed probability \(0<p<1\); independent centered finite-variance exploration steps. Does not cover bias, fading kernels or infinite-variance steps; exact limit law not identified. Closest barycenter literature uses a different recursive parent/edge law; definitive historical priority and independent mathematical validation are not established.
title: A random limiting trajectory centroid with a logarithmic variance correction for uniform-history relocation walks
